scripts.build:react: vite build --config vite.bridge.config.js && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/prune-react-chunks.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:legacy && npm run build:react
scripts.android:add: npm run build:mobile && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync android
scripts.vercel-build: npm run check && npm run build:updates
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build:updates && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.lint: npm run build:legacy && eslint server.mjs lib/routes lib/server lib/http lib/ai/provider.js lib/ai/doctrine.js lib/ai/safety.js lib/bible/provider.js assets/legacy.js
